levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: «عن جعفر بن محمد» (occurrence 1) is Hafs's habit of narrating from Ja'far, read as description, not a link (rule 6); the last link is the saying «حدثني خير الجعافر جعفر بن محمد» (occurrence 2)
The Imam is named in the words after the chain: imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the blessing is left out
